title: Common Crawl 2015 Tor2web body-acquisition boundary

target.description: Exact response-body acquisition from two frozen 2015 Common Crawl indexes

summary: The frozen runtime could reach archive documentation but could not retrieve parameterized CDX results or exact WARC byte ranges; no capture body entered the hash test.
why_run: To test a provenance-bearing external-byte route without substituting filenames, live pages, reconstructed HTML, or synthetic payloads.

pipeline.description: Query frozen URL forms, preserve CDX metadata, range-fetch exact WARC records, extract unnormalized response payloads, and compare direct SHA-512 with the declared target.

acceptance.criterion: Exact WARC response-body SHA-512 equals the frozen target.

controls: Only the two declared crawl indexes and three root mirror forms were authorized.
The preregistered stop condition required an acquisition-blocked result when exact WARC bytes were unavailable.
interpretation: This is an infrastructure/acquisition null. It does not test whether the frozen crawls contain relevant captures.
limitations: No capture metadata or page body entered the hash test.
The execution environment and querying implementation were not preserved sufficiently for full reproduction.
The original archive contains forward research instructions that are excluded from the public normalized package.

normalization_changes: Converted historical fields to the HMS run schema.
Preserved the report, result, and frozen contract as normalized UTF-8 text.
Excluded forward next-slice instructions from the public package.

raw_artifacts.reason: The normalized public subset preserves evidence used for this conclusion while excluding forward research instructions.
